expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return JSON.stringify({ watchCard: t.includes('Autonomous watch'), watchOn: t.includes('ON'), scoresEvery: t.includes('Scores the platform every'), lastAction: (t.match(/re-enqueue-deadletters|reprobe-mesh/g)||[]).slice(0,2), scoreLine: (t.match(/\d+ · \w+/g)||[]).slice(0,2) }); })()
